mapper.update: UPDATE rel_share_link SET visit_count = visit_count + 1, status = CASE WHEN visit_limit IS NOT NULL AND visit_count + 1 >= visit_limit THEN 'EXHAUSTED' ELSE status END, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at > #{now} AND (visit_limit IS NULL OR visit_count < visit_limit)
